verdict.rationale: Adyen publishes an official GitHub repo (Adyen/adyen-openapi) of OpenAPI definitions that can be downloaded and loaded into Swagger Editor or SwaggerHub, so a machine-readable spec exists for Adyen APIs. The evidence does not show that the agentic-specific APIs (Agentic Cart API, Feed API, ACP/UCP agent-platform flows) are in that repo. The probe found no spec at guessed docs-site paths, which only means there is no discoverable spec on the docs domain, not that the GitHub definitions don't work. Missing for 10: confirmation that the Agentic Commerce APIs are covered by the published OpenAPI definitions, a spec discoverable from the agentic docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
